<!-- Shared by index.qmd and en/index.qmd. Expects OJS variables `lang`, `root`. -->
```{ojs}
//| echo: false
import { strings } from "/assets/strings.js"
import { link, paperLink, split } from "/assets/catalog.js"
t = strings[lang]
catalog = d3.json(root + "data/catalog.json")
papers = d3.json(root + "data/papers.json")
paperYears = papers.map(d => d.year).filter(Boolean)
htl.html`<section class="hero hero-photo" style="background-image: linear-gradient(100deg, rgba(20,45,28,.88) 0%, rgba(20,45,28,.55) 55%, rgba(20,45,28,.15) 100%), url(${root}assets/photos/hero.jpg)">
  <h1>${t.tagline}</h1>
  <p>${t.lede}</p>
  <span class="photo-credit">${t.heroCredit}</span>
</section>`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
stat = (n, label) => htl.html`<div class="stat"><b>${n.toLocaleString()}</b><span>${label}</span></div>`
panel = (cls, title, text, stats, links) => htl.html`<section class="panel ${cls}">
  <h2>${title}</h2>
  <p>${text}</p>
  <div class="stats">${stats}</div>
  <div class="panel-links">${links.map(([href, label]) => htl.html`<a class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm" href="${href}">${label}</a>`)}</div>
</section>`
htl.html`<div class="panels">
  ${panel("panel-data", t.panelData, t.panelDataText, [
      stat(catalog.length, t.statDatasets),
      stat(new Set(catalog.map(d => d.publisher)).size, t.statRepos),
      stat(new Set(catalog.flatMap(d => split(d.taxa))).size, t.statTaxa)],
    [["explore.html", t.linkSearchData], ["browse.html", t.linkAllData], ["map.html", t.linkMap]])}
  ${panel("panel-papers", t.panelPapers, t.panelPapersText, [
      stat(papers.length, t.statPapers),
      stat(papers.filter(d => d.is_oa).length, t.statOA),
      htl.html`<div class="stat"><b>${paperYears.length ? `${d3.min(paperYears)}–${d3.max(paperYears)}` : "–"}</b><span>${t.statSpan}</span></div>`],
    [["papers.html", t.linkSearchPapers], ["papers-table.html", t.linkAllPapers]])}
</div>
<a class="contribute-strip" href="contribute.html">
  <div><h3>${t.contributeTitle}</h3><p>${t.contributeText}</p></div>
  <span class="btn btn-primary">${t.contributeLink}</span>
</a>`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
featured = catalog.filter(d => d.featured)
newest = papers.slice().sort((a, b) => (b.year ?? 0) - (a.year ?? 0) || String(b.added).localeCompare(String(a.added))).slice(0, 5)
htl.html`<div class="home-lists">
<div>
<h2>${t.featured}</h2>
${featured.length === 0 ? htl.html`<p>${t.none}</p>` : featured.map(d => htl.html`
  <div class="dataset-card">
    <h4><a href="${link(d)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">${d.title}</a></h4>
    <div class="dataset-meta">${d.creators || ""} · ${d.year ?? ""} · ${d.publisher || ""}</div>
    ${(lang === "es" ? d.note_es : d.note_en) ? htl.html`<p class="mt-2 mb-0">${lang === "es" ? d.note_es : d.note_en}</p>` : ""}
  </div>`)}
</div>
<div>
<h2>${t.newestPapers}</h2>
${newest.length === 0 ? htl.html`<p>${t.noPapers}</p>` : newest.map(d => htl.html`
  <div class="dataset-card paper-card">
    <h4><a href="${paperLink(d)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">${d.title}</a></h4>
    <div class="dataset-meta">${split(d.authors).slice(0, 3).join("; ")}${split(d.authors).length > 3 ? " et al." : ""} · ${d.year ?? ""}${d.venue ? " · " + d.venue : ""}</div>
  </div>`)}
<p><a href="papers.html">${t.allPapersLink}</a></p>
</div>
</div>`
```
